title: Cross-Agency Rating Mapping
user_story: As a credit risk analyst, I want to convert a rating between the Moody's-style and Fitch-style scales so that I can compare issuers rated by different agencies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each Moody's-style symbol maps to exactly one Fitch-style symbol according to the cross-agency mapping table (e.g. Aaa<->AAA, Aa2<->AA, Baa3<->BBB-, Caa3<->CCC-, Ca<->CC, C<->C).
Mapping is symmetric for all symbols from AAA/Aaa down to C: converting a rating to the other scale and back returns the original symbol.
Fitch-style RD and D map one-way to Moody's-style C, and the response sets lossy=true. For all other conversions lossy=false.
Status codes (WR, WD, NR) cannot be mapped; the system returns error code NOT_MAPPABLE.
Invalid input symbols are rejected with error code INVALID_RATING_SYMBOL, using the same validation as R1.
The response includes source_agency, source_symbol, target_agency, target_symbol, lossy, and common_rank (1 = highest, 21 = lowest; equal to the Moody's-style ordinal position).
